title: PassengerFacts
description: The typed interface between the neural half and the symbolic half. The reasoner never sees free text - only an object that validates against this schema.

age.description: Age in completed years on the day of travel. A value outside 0-120 is an extraction error, not an unusual passenger.

student.description: Holds a valid full-time student card. NOTE: enrolment is not enough - the discount requires the card. A person who studies but cannot show the card is student=false.

has_id.description: Can present photo ID at inspection. Not used by the fare rules in this lab, but it is in the schema, so it must still validate.

fare.description: 'abstain' is a first-class outcome, not an error. It means the system declined to decide and the case escalates.

rule.description: Identifier of the rule that fired: R1, R2, R3, R4-fallback, or R0-invalid-input.

facts_used.description: Names of the facts the firing rule actually read. This is the derivation. An empty list on a non-abstain decision is a bug.

reason.description: Optional human-readable gloss. Rendering only - it must never carry information the rule did not.
